Requirement description: The system shall load an experiment configuration from a YAML file that conforms to a versioned schema covering simulator, noise, disturbance, controller, residual-model, gate, metric and experiment-plan parameters.
Acceptance criterion: configs/paper_default.yaml loads without error; every field in the schema is populated.

Requirement description: The system shall validate every configuration parameter against its type and allowed range before execution and shall report all violations (parameter name, supplied value, allowed range); no trial shall start while any violation exists.
Acceptance criterion: Each invalid fixture (dt <= 0, n_trials < 1, kappa <= 0, negative noise s.d., empty controller list, threshold <= 0) yields exactly one issue naming the field; runner executes zero trials.

Requirement description: The system shall provide a 'paper_default' preset containing every constant of the paper's Table I and the protocol of Sections V-VI, each annotated with its paper source, and a 'paper_mismatch' preset containing the Section VII-D disturbance field.
Acceptance criterion: All Table I values (dt, T, z0, v_des, m, J_x, A_GE, R_z, K_phi, L, lambda, PID gains, noise s.d.) equal the paper values; unresolved items carry a 'TBC' annotation.

Requirement description: The system shall derive per-trial seeds deterministically from a master seed and shall assign the same seed sequence to every controller within a condition.
Acceptance criterion: Two calls with the same master seed return identical arrays; seeds for PID and Res-NG in one condition are identical.

Requirement description: The system shall save the fully resolved configuration, derived seeds, ResLand version, Git commit hash and dependency versions with every run.
Acceptance criterion: Every run directory contains both files; re-running from config.resolved.yaml reproduces trials.csv exactly (see FR-ERR-02).

Requirement description: The system shall initialise each trial at relative altitude z0 = 4.0 m with lateral offset y0 ~ N(0, 0.5^2) m and roll angle phi0 ~ N(0, 0.03^2) rad; initial v_z, v_y and p shall be configurable (defaults TBC, see OI-08).
Acceptance criterion: Over 10,000 sampled trials the sample mean and s.d. of y0 and phi0 lie within 3 standard errors of the specified values; z0 = 4.0 exactly.

Requirement description: The system shall scale K_phi by U(0.80, 1.20), A_GE by U(0.85, 1.15), J_x by U(0.90, 1.10) and the nominal platform speed by U(0.90, 1.10) independently for each trial.
Acceptance criterion: All sampled scalings lie within their bounds; empirical means within 3 standard errors of the interval midpoints over 10,000 samples.

Requirement description: The system shall record each trial's sampled initial state, parameter scalings and seed in the per-trial results.
Acceptance criterion: trials.csv contains seed, y0, phi0, K_phi_scale, A_GE_scale, Jx_scale, v_p for every row; re-running one row's seed reproduces its metrics.

Requirement description: The system shall propagate the state [z, v_z, y, v_y, phi, p] with a fixed integration step dt = 0.01 s (100 Hz) for at most T = 12 s.
Acceptance criterion: One step from a hand-computed state matches the analytical update to 1e-12; a trajectory never exceeds 1,200 steps.

Requirement description: The system shall couple lateral and roll dynamics through dv_y/dt = (u_z + g) tan(phi).
Acceptance criterion: For phi in {-0.1, 0, 0.1} rad and u_z in {-1, 0, 1} m/s^2 the computed derivative equals (u_z + 9.81) tan(phi) to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall integrate roll dynamics J_x dp/dt = u_phi + tau_DAGE + tau_noise and vertical dynamics dv_z/dt = u_z + a_GE(z) + w_z, where the vertical form is a proposed reading pending OI-02.
Acceptance criterion: With noise disabled, single-step updates of p and v_z match the stated equations to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall add zero-mean Gaussian measurement noise with s.d. 0.010 m (z), 0.030 m/s (v_z), 0.004 rad (phi) and 0.020 rad/s (p) at every step, and process noise of configurable magnitude (TBC, OI-05).
Acceptance criterion: Over 100,000 draws the sample s.d. of each noise channel is within 2% of the configured value and |mean| < 3 standard errors.

Requirement description: The system shall model the landing platform as translating laterally at constant speed v_p (randomised per trial) with relative altitude z measured to the platform surface.
Acceptance criterion: Platform position after k steps equals y_p0 + k dt v_p to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall expose the injected tau_DAGE and a_GE at every step as ground-truth signals in the trajectory log.
Acceptance criterion: Logged values equal DisturbanceModel outputs recomputed from the logged true state to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall compute tau_DAGE = K_phi [v_y + lambda_slip (v_y - v_p)] cos(phi) / (1 + (z/L)^n_phi) with configurable K_phi, lambda_slip, L and decay exponent n_phi (default 2.0).
Acceptance criterion: Values at 6 reference points (including v_y = v_p, z = 0, z = L, phi = 0.1) match hand-computed values to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall compute a_GE = A_GE / (1 + (z/R_z)^n_z) with configurable A_GE, R_z and exponent n_z (default 2.0).
Acceptance criterion: Values at z in {0, R_z, 2R_z} match hand-computed values; exponent 1.6 accepted for the mismatch profile.

Requirement description: The system shall support named disturbance profiles ('nominal', 'mismatch' and user-defined) and shall allow the training profile and the evaluation profile to be selected independently.
Acceptance criterion: 'mismatch' resolves to K_phi x1.40, A_GE x1.35, L x1.30, R_z x1.40, n = 1.6, lambda_slip = 1.00; a run with train='nominal', eval='mismatch' logs both.

Requirement description: The system should allow each disturbance term (airspeed term, slip term, vertical ground effect, process noise) to be disabled independently for ablation.
Acceptance criterion: With all terms disabled and noise off, tau_DAGE = a_GE = 0 at every step.

Requirement description: The system shall implement the cascaded PID controller: vertical PID on altitude error (K_P = 2.2, K_D = 2.6, K_I = 1.6), lateral outer loop mapping lateral-velocity error to a roll set-point (gains TBC, OI-01), and inner roll PID u_phi = J_x (K_P e_phi + K_D de_phi/dt + K_I int e_phi dt) with (60, 11, 30).
Acceptance criterion: For a scripted error sequence the controller output matches a hand-computed PID response to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall implement the PD configuration as the same cascade with all integral gains equal to zero.
Acceptance criterion: PD output equals PID output with K_I = 0 for identical inputs.

Requirement description: All five controller configurations (PD, PID, PID+DOB, Res-NG, Res-G) shall implement one Controller interface: reset(batch_size, rng) and compute(obs, ref) -> Command.
Acceptance criterion: Each configuration passes the interface conformance test and returns finite commands of shape [B].

Requirement description: The system shall track the commanded descent rate v_des = 0.42 m/s from z0 using a configurable altitude reference (default z_ref(t) = max(z0 - v_des t, 0), TBC OI-03).
Acceptance criterion: z_ref(0) = 4.0 m, z_ref(5 s) = 1.9 m; never negative.

Requirement description: The system should support optional command saturation and integrator anti-windup, disabled in the 'paper_default' preset because the paper does not specify them (OI-21).
Acceptance criterion: When enabled, |u_phi| and |u_z| never exceed configured bounds over a 1,000-step saturating input; when disabled, outputs equal the unbounded law.

Requirement description: The system shall implement the PID+DOB configuration: a first-order disturbance observer with time constant 1.0 s on the vertical channel, driven by measured vertical acceleration, whose estimate is subtracted from u_z.
Acceptance criterion: For a constant additive vertical disturbance without noise, |d_hat - d| / |d| < 1% after 5 s (5 time constants).

Requirement description: The system shall log the DOB estimate at every step for the PID+DOB configuration.
Acceptance criterion: Trajectory log for PID+DOB contains a finite dob_hat array of trajectory length.

Requirement description: The system shall generate a training dataset from 400 PID-controlled trajectories with platform speed drawn from U(0, 4.0) m/s and the per-trial randomisation of FR-INIT-02, using data seed 42; speeds 5.0 and 6.0 m/s shall never appear in training data.
Acceptance criterion: Dataset metadata reports 400 trajectories; max nominal platform speed <= 4.0 m/s; same seed reproduces identical arrays.

Requirement description: The system shall split data by trajectory (60 held-out, 340 training) and sub-sample 200,000 training windows; no trajectory shall contribute windows to both sets.
Acceptance criterion: Intersection of train and validation traj_id sets is empty; counts are 340/60 trajectories and 200,000 training windows.

Requirement description: The system shall train the residual MLP by minimising MSE on standardised targets plus lambda_reg ||theta||^2 (1e-5), with Adam (lr 8e-4, decay 0.94 per epoch), batch 256, dropout 0.05, Gaussian input noise 0.02, gradient-norm clipping 5.0, early stopping (patience 6) restoring the best epoch, and initialisation seed 1.
Acceptance criterion: On a synthetic loss sequence early stopping restores the minimum-validation epoch; on a 20-trajectory dataset one epoch reduces training loss.

Requirement description: The system shall export each trained model as PyTorch weights, an equivalent NumPy .npz, normalisation statistics, gate calibration, training log, model card and SHA-256 checksum.
Acceptance criterion: All seven files exist; NumPy and PyTorch inference agree to 1e-5 on 1,000 random windows.

Requirement description: The system shall maintain a sliding window of the last W = 4 steps of [phi, p, z, v_z, u_phi, u_z] (noisy measurements and nominal commands) to form the 24-dimensional input H_t; before the window is full the residual output shall be zero (proposed, OI-14).
Acceptance criterion: After 5 pushes the buffer returns the last 4 steps in documented order; during the first 3 steps residual output is 0.

Requirement description: The system shall implement the residual network as a fully connected 24 -> 64 -> 64 -> 32 -> 2 MLP with tanh hidden activations and a linear output layer (output activation proposed, OI-13), outputs tau_hat_phi and a_hat_z.
Acceptance criterion: Parameter count = 7,906; multiply-accumulate count per pass = 7,744; output shape [B,2].

Requirement description: The system shall standardise inputs with training mean and s.d. and de-standardise outputs to physical units before use.
Acceptance criterion: standardise(destandardise(x)) = x to 1e-12; statistics are loaded from the same artefact as the weights.

Requirement description: The system shall apply the residual correction as tau_phi,total = tau_phi,nom - sigma tau_hat_phi and u_z,total = u_z,nom - sigma a_hat_z.
Acceptance criterion: With sigma = 0 the closed-loop trajectory is identical to PID for the same seed; with sigma = 1 applied command equals nominal minus prediction to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall load a model artefact only if its architecture, feature schema version and SHA-256 checksum match, and shall reject it otherwise with a descriptive error.
Acceptance criterion: Valid artefact loads; artefacts with altered shape, schema version or one flipped byte are rejected.

Requirement description: The system shall compute d(H_t) = max_i |H_t,i - mu_i| / s_i over the 24 features using training statistics.
Acceptance criterion: On crafted vectors d equals the maximum (not the mean) standardised deviation.

Requirement description: The system shall compute sigma = clip(exp(-max(0, d - d0)/kappa), 0, 1) with configurable d0 and kappa > 0.
Acceptance criterion: sigma = 1 for d <= d0; sigma = exp(-1) at d = d0 + kappa; sigma -> 0 as d -> infinity; kappa <= 0 rejected; non-finite H_t gives sigma = 0.

Requirement description: The system shall calibrate d0 as a configurable percentile (default 0.99) of d over held-out in-distribution windows and store it with the model artefact.
Acceptance criterion: On synthetic data with known distribution the computed percentile equals numpy.quantile to 1e-12.

Requirement description: The system shall support ungated residual control (sigma = 1) and gate-ablation sweeps over kappa and a d0 scale factor.
Acceptance criterion: Res-G with d0 = infinity produces trajectories identical to Res-NG; ablation plan expands to 12 cells plus the ungated reference.

Requirement description: The system shall log sigma, d and the magnitudes of the gated and ungated corrections at every step for gated controllers, and report the condition mean sigma_bar.
Acceptance criterion: Logged sigma lies in [0, 1]; sigma_bar equals the mean of logged sigma over all steps and trials of the condition (averaging basis TBC).

Requirement description: The system shall execute N randomised trials (1 <= N <= 10,000; default 500) for each condition defined by controller, nominal platform speed and disturbance profile.
Acceptance criterion: A run with 3 controllers x 2 speeds x N = 20 produces exactly 120 trial rows.

Requirement description: The system shall provide experiment plans reproducing the paper's speed sweep (5 controllers x {0, 1.5, 3.0, 5.0, 6.0} m/s), mismatch study ({1.5, 3.0, 5.0} m/s; PD, PID, Res-NG, Res-G) and gate ablation (6.0 m/s, 300 trials per cell).
Acceptance criterion: Plans expand to 25, 12 and 13 conditions respectively.

Requirement description: The system shall report progress (completed and total trials) at least once per completed batch and shall allow cancellation, leaving completed batches readable on disk.
Acceptance criterion: Cancelling a 2,500-trial run after the first batch leaves a readable trials.csv with a whole number of batches and status CANCELLED.

Requirement description: The system shall detect touchdown at the first step at which true relative altitude z <= 0 (proposed, OI-06), record the contact state and terminate that trial.
Acceptance criterion: A scripted descent crossing z = 0 between steps k and k+1 is detected at k+1; the contact state equals the state at k+1.

Requirement description: The system shall mark trials that do not touch down within T = 12 s as NO_TOUCHDOWN and count them as envelope failures.
Acceptance criterion: A hover-only command yields NO_TOUCHDOWN and envelope_success = False.

Requirement description: The system shall compute RMS(phi) and peak |phi| over the final approach, defined as steps with z < 1.0 m.
Acceptance criterion: On a synthetic trajectory the metrics equal hand-computed values to 1e-12; steps with z >= 1.0 m are excluded.

Requirement description: The system shall compute lateral velocity mismatch |v_y - v_p| and impact speed |v_z| at contact.
Acceptance criterion: Values equal those of the logged contact state.

Requirement description: The system shall classify a trial as envelope success when |phi| <= 0.10 rad, |v_z| <= 0.75 m/s and |v_y - v_p| <= 0.75 m/s (thresholds configurable; time at which |phi| is evaluated TBC, OI-07).
Acceptance criterion: Boundary cases exactly at each threshold are classified as success (inclusive); any value 1e-9 above is failure.

Requirement description: The system shall classify a roll violation when peak final-approach |phi| exceeds 0.10 rad.
Acceptance criterion: peak_phi = 0.10 gives False; 0.1000001 gives True.

Requirement description: The system shall compare any subset of the five controller configurations within the same condition and seed set.
Acceptance criterion: Comparison table has one row per selected controller per condition; all rows share the same seed set.

Requirement description: The system shall compute paired differences of scalar metrics against a reference controller (default PID) with 95% paired-bootstrap intervals over 20,000 resamples using a recorded seed.
Acceptance criterion: For a constant difference c the interval is [c, c]; identical seeds give identical intervals; unpaired inputs raise PairingError.

Requirement description: The system shall report the mean gate value sigma_bar per condition for gated controllers.
Acceptance criterion: sigma_bar present for Res-NG (1.000) and Res-G; absent (NaN) for non-residual controllers.

Requirement description: The system shall plot time histories of altitude, vertical velocity, roll angle and lateral velocity mismatch for one or more controllers run on the same seed.
Acceptance criterion: Figure contains one trace per controller per selected signal; final-approach region (z < 1 m) is shaded.

Requirement description: The system shall show a schematic side view of the UAV and moving platform, animated over the trajectory with a time slider.
Acceptance criterion: Slider spans 0 to t_touchdown; UAV icon tilts by phi; platform moves at v_p.

Requirement description: The system shall plot the gate value sigma and the residual corrections over time for residual controllers.
Acceptance criterion: Plot shows sigma in [0, 1] and both correction channels for Res-G.

Requirement description: The system shall aggregate each condition into means of scalar metrics and envelope-success and roll-violation rates with Wilson 95% score intervals.
The system shall render aggregate results in the column layout of the paper's Tables III, IV and V.
Acceptance criterion: Rendered Table III has columns v_p, Controller, RMS phi, Peak phi, |dv_y|, |v_z|, Envelope success [CI], Roll viol., sigma_bar.

Requirement description: The system shall label every displayed or exported value as 'Reproduced' (computed by this software) or 'Paper-reported' and shall never mix them in one column without a label.
Acceptance criterion: Every exported CSV has a 'source' column; dashboard comparison tables show a provenance badge.

Requirement description: The system shall save every run to results/<run_id>/ containing config.resolved.yaml, manifest.json, trials.csv, aggregate.csv, paired_diffs.csv and run.log.
Acceptance criterion: All six files exist after a completed run; CSV headers match the documented schema.

Requirement description: The system shall export figures as PNG (>= 150 dpi) and SVG and tables as CSV from the dashboard and the CLI.
Acceptance criterion: Exported PNG opens with width >= 1200 px; SVG parses as XML; CSV re-reads to an identical DataFrame.

Requirement description: The system shall reload a saved run into the dashboard without re-running any simulation.
Acceptance criterion: Aggregates displayed after reload are identical to those displayed at run completion.

Requirement description: The system could export a Markdown run summary with the resolved configuration, aggregate tables and key figures.
Acceptance criterion: summary.md lists run_id, plan, controllers, speeds and embeds aggregate tables.

Requirement description: The system shall detect non-finite state values or |phi| above a configurable divergence limit (default pi/2 rad, proposed), terminate that trial with outcome DIVERGED, and continue the experiment.
Acceptance criterion: Injecting NaN into one trial of a 50-trial batch yields 1 DIVERGED and 49 completed trials.

Requirement description: The system shall produce identical per-trial results when the same resolved configuration, seeds and model artefact are re-run on the same platform and dependency versions.
Acceptance criterion: Two runs of the regression configuration produce byte-identical trials.csv.

Requirement description: The system shall provide command-line entry points to generate data, train, calibrate the gate, run any plan and reproduce paper tables, returning a non-zero exit code on failure.
Acceptance criterion: Each sub-command runs on the 'smoke' configuration and exits 0; an invalid config exits 2 with the validation report.

Requirement description: The system shall write structured log records (timestamp, level, module, run_id, message) to run.log for every run.
Acceptance criterion: run.log contains start, per-batch progress, completion or error records for a test run.

Requirement description: The dashboard shall provide an Experiment Setup screen with controller selection, platform speed(s), disturbance profile and parameters, random seed, number of trials and live configuration validation.
Acceptance criterion: All fields of the wireframe W-01 are present; invalid input disables Run and shows the M1 message beside the field.

Requirement description: The dashboard shall provide a Simulation View showing the side-view animation and live signals for a selected trial.
Acceptance criterion: Selecting any trial of a finished run displays its animation and four signal plots.

Requirement description: The dashboard shall provide a Controller Comparison screen with overlaid roll angle, lateral velocity mismatch, altitude and vertical velocity for selected controllers on a common seed.
Acceptance criterion: Four synchronised plots render for any 2-5 selected controllers.

Requirement description: The dashboard shall provide a Results and Analysis screen with envelope-success rates and Wilson intervals, roll error, impact speed, paired differences, provenance labels and export controls.
Acceptance criterion: Table and bar chart with CI whiskers render; CSV/PNG downloads work (ST-06).

Requirement description: Each screen shall implement empty, loading/progress, validation-error, run-error and completion states as specified in the wireframes.
Acceptance criterion: Each state is reachable in Streamlit AppTest and shows the specified message text.

Requirement description: A single 500-trial condition for any controller shall complete within 60 s on the reference machine (to be fixed: the team's development laptop, CPU only).
Acceptance criterion: Measured wall-clock time for PID and Res-G at 500 trials <= 60 s, median of 3 runs.

Requirement description: Regenerating the full Table III plan (25 conditions x 500 trials) shall complete within 30 minutes on the reference machine.
Acceptance criterion: Measured wall-clock time <= 30 min.

Requirement description: During a run the dashboard shall update progress at least every 2 s and shall respond to a cancel request within one batch.
Acceptance criterion: Progress timestamps show gaps <= 2 s; cancel honoured before the next batch starts.

Requirement description: The residual network shall require exactly 7,744 multiply-accumulate operations per forward pass; per-step inference time shall be measured and reported, not asserted against an embedded-hardware figure.
Acceptance criterion: Analytical MAC count = 7,744; measured per-batch inference time recorded in the test report.

Requirement description: Every numeric input on the dashboard shall show its unit and allowed range, and every validation message shall name the field and the allowed range.
Acceptance criterion: Inspection of all Setup fields; ST-04 messages contain field name and range.

Requirement description: A first-time user shall be able to run a 50-trial PID vs Res-NG comparison from the default preset in at most 5 interactions.
Acceptance criterion: Scripted walkthrough counts <= 5 clicks/inputs.

Requirement description: Module dependencies shall follow the layered architecture (UI -> Runner -> Simulator/Controllers/Model/Gate -> Config) with no import cycles.
Acceptance criterion: import-linter contract passes in CI.

Requirement description: All public functions and classes shall have type hints and docstrings citing the requirement IDs they implement; code shall pass ruff lint and format checks.
Acceptance criterion: ruff check and ruff format --check exit 0; script lists public symbols without requirement IDs = 0.

Requirement description: Adding a new controller shall require only a new class implementing Controller and a registry entry, with no change to M6, M7 or M8.
Acceptance criterion: Demonstrated by adding a dummy controller in a test without modifying runner/evaluation code.

Requirement description: A failure in one trial (exception or divergence) shall not abort the experiment; it shall be recorded with an outcome code.
Acceptance criterion: UT-26 and fault-injection test pass.

Requirement description: Results shall be written per completed batch using write-to-temporary-then-rename so that an interruption never leaves a truncated CSV.
Acceptance criterion: Killing the process mid-run leaves trials.csv parseable with whole batches.

Requirement description: Same configuration, seeds and model artefact on the same platform shall yield byte-identical trials.csv; model training shall be repeatable within a documented tolerance using fixed seeds and deterministic PyTorch settings.
Acceptance criterion: RT-01 byte-identical; two training runs give validation MSE within 1% relative (tolerance TBC).

Requirement description: Dependency versions shall be pinned in a lock file and recorded in each run's manifest.
Acceptance criterion: manifest.json lists Python and all package versions.

Requirement description: The system shall run on Windows 10/11 and Ubuntu 22.04 or later with Python 3.10-3.12, CPU only; a GPU shall be optional for training.
Acceptance criterion: Smoke test passes on Windows and Linux (CI matrix).

Requirement description: Automated pytest suite with statement coverage >= 80% for M1-M7.
Acceptance criterion: pytest --cov report >= 80% for src/resland excluding ui/.

Requirement description: Every functional requirement shall map to at least one test case in the traceability matrix.
Acceptance criterion: RTM check script reports zero unmapped requirements.

Requirement description: Every results file shall carry a schema version, and each trial row shall be uniquely keyed by (run_id, condition_id, controller, trial_idx).
Acceptance criterion: Uniqueness check passes; schema_version present.

Requirement description: Model artefacts shall be verified by SHA-256 before loading, and loading shall use non-executable formats (NumPy .npz, or torch.load with weights_only=True).
Acceptance criterion: UT-16 rejects altered artefacts; code inspection shows no unsafe pickle loading.

Requirement description: Paper-reported reference values shall be stored separately (spec/paper_reference/) and labelled; they shall never be written into a run's results files.
Acceptance criterion: Inspection of writers; ST-06 provenance check.
